item.title: 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art: A Circular Museum With No Front or Back — Guide
item.description: The 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art is housed in a distinctive circular glass building designed with no defined front or back, intended to be equally approachable from every direction, and has become one of Kanazawa’s most visited cultural landmarks since opening in 2004. The museum’s best-known work is Leandro Erlich’s ‘Swimming Pool’ installation, which creates the illusion of a submerged pool viewable from both above and below, and several public exhibition spaces around the building can be enjoyed free of charge without a ticket to the paid galleries.
